selection_rule: One independently phrased task query per wave-two candidate, written by a reviewer before running the search; five unrelated no-answer controls.

Compute the support service time excluding paused periods and closed hours.
Which upstream column and transformation created this dashboard total?
The vendor feed status column has the right name but means something different.
What exactly did the sales team promise that implementation has not scheduled?
Should we focus on developer forums or paid search to reach this buyer group?
Are payments, signup, support, and docs ready before announcing the product?
Turn this customer's error report into a safe reproducible handoff for engineering.
Can we connect our product to a partner without unclear data sharing or owner duties?
We can support only a few beta accounts; which applicants fit the shipped capability?
Our internal champion likes it; who can approve spending and what review is left?
Several interviewees complained, but one person repeated it; what is the actual signal?
May the agent call this MCP tool to modify a different account than approved?
Did the shorter instructions for the small model lose a mandatory safety clause?
Where should selected skills and references be placed for a new coding agent run?
How do we prove a withdrawn library item cannot be downloaded through a stale link?
